site.title: Cutefish - Linux distribution and desktop environment
site.description: Cutefish, also known as CutefishOS, is a Linux distribution built around Cutefish Desktop, a calm, fast desktop environment with its own compositor, toolkit and applications.
home.title: Simple. Calm. Yours.
home.lead: Cutefish is a Linux distribution built around Cutefish Desktop, a desktop environment with its own Wayland compositor, toolkit and applications, designed together so every part looks and moves the same way.
features.shell.title: Dock, Launcher and Overview
features.shell.body: A dock for running and favourite applications, a full-screen launcher, and an overview of every window and desk.
features.desks.title: Virtual desks
features.desks.body: Spread your work over several desks and move between them with a three-finger sideways swipe.
features.glass.title: Glass surfaces
features.glass.body: Panels, menus and the dock blur and tint the wallpaper behind them.
features.compositor.title: Own compositor
features.compositor.body: cutefish-compositor is a Wayland compositor written for this desktop. It draws the shell, window effects and animations itself.
features.toolkit.title: Own toolkit
features.toolkit.body: Every Cutefish application is built on cutefish-toolkit, a native C++ toolkit drawn with Skia.
features.apps.title: Applications
features.apps.body: Files, Terminal, Settings, Calendar, System Monitor, Text Editor, Video Player and screen capture come with the desktop.

about.title: About
about.lead: Cutefish is a Linux distribution, and Cutefish Desktop is the desktop environment at its heart.
about.body: The compositor, toolkit, shell and applications are developed together, in the open. Most of Cutefish is released under the BSD 3-Clause License; a few components that carry GPL code, such as the terminal, remain under the GPL.
about.officialBody: cutefish.org is the only official website of Cutefish, and github.com/cutefishos is its only source code home. Other domains carrying the Cutefish name are not operated by this project.
about.supportBody: If you would like to support the development of Cutefish, you can sponsor it monthly or once through GitHub Sponsors.
